name: Leonardo AW169
summary: A modern twin-turbine helicopter with a five-blade rotor, retractable landing gear and a sleek nose; used for EMS and VIP work.

wings: Five-blade main rotor on a short mast
Rotor head blends into a smooth dorsal fairing
engines: Twin turboshafts under a long dorsal fairing
Exhaust on both sides at the rear
fuselage: Sleek swept nose with large windows
tail: Upswept boom with a conventional tail rotor

tellTales: Five-blade rotor on a sleek twin-engine helicopter
Retractable wheeled gear and no skids
Pointed swept nose with large windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The AW139 is larger with a boxier fuselage and bigger sponsons; the AW169 is smaller and sleeker.
The AW109 has a four-blade rotor and a smaller body; the AW169 has five blades and a bigger cabin.
The H145 has clamshell rear doors and fixed skids; the AW169 has retractable wheels.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
